title: Clearing the FoG: Training KG Agents to Retrieve the Evidence Behind Their Answers
title_zh: 拨开迷雾（FoG）：训练知识图谱智能体检索答案背后的证据

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) can answer many factual questions correctly, but a correct answer is not necessarily a supported one. For an LLM agent, a knowledge graph (KG) plays two roles: as a source of answers, it supplies facts that the model lacks; as a source of evidence, it supplies the supporting triples that make an answer traceable and auditable. However, existing KG agents treat the KG only as a source of answers: their training data carries answers but not evidence, and their training rewards check the answer but not the retrieved evidence, so agents often answer correctly without retrieving the supporting triples. We propose FoG , a framework that trains KG agents to retrieve the evidence behind their answers. FoG consists of evidence-grounded synthesis, a KG interaction agent, and an evidence-coverage process reward (ECPR): the synthesis recursively hides explicit entities behind verifiable sub-questions, so that every question carries its supporting triples by construction; the agent records the triples returned by the KG; and ECPR credits each supporting triple to the turn that first retrieves it. Experiments on three KGQA benchmarks demonstrate that FoG enables 3B–4B open-source agents to outperform substantially larger baselines in answer accuracy and evidence coverage, with zero-shot cross-KG transfer.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）能够正确回答许多事实性问题，但正确的答案未必是有依据支撑的答案。 对于一个 LLM 智能体而言，知识图谱（KG）扮演两种角色：作为答案来源，它提供模型所缺失的事实；作为证据来源，它提供使答案可追溯、可审计的支持三元组。 然而，现有的 KG 智能体仅把 KG 当作答案来源：其训练数据包含答案但不包含证据，其训练奖励只检验答案而不检验检索到的证据，因此智能体常常在不检索支持三元组的情况下给出正确答案。 我们提出 FoG，一个训练 KG 智能体检索答案背后证据的框架。 FoG 由证据扎根式合成、KG 交互智能体和证据覆盖过程奖励（ECPR）组成：合成过程递归地将显式实体隐藏在可验证的子问题之后，使每个问题在构造上就自带其支持三元组；智能体记录 KG 返回的三元组；ECPR 将每条支持三元组记入首次检索到它的那个轮次。 在三个 KGQA 基准上的实验表明，FoG 使 3B–4B 的开源智能体在答案准确率和证据覆盖率上显著超越规模大得多的基线模型，并具备零样本的跨 KG 迁移能力。

We identify two causes. First, training data carries answers but not evidence : most KGQA datasets annotate answers and at most logical forms Talmor and Berant (2018) ; Yih et al. (2016) ; Gu et al. (2021) , and recovering the supporting triples afterwards requires enumerating and verifying paths for every question. Second, training rewards check the answer but not the evidence : most rewards score only the final answer or whether the KG returns it Lin et al. (2025) ; Song et al. (2026) ; Xu et al. (2026) ; Chen et al. (2025) ; Sun et al. (2025) , so a trajectory that reaches the answer through part of the evidence earns as much as one that retrieves all of it. The process rewards that go further depend on an LLM judge or on gold paths recovered for every question Wang and Yu (2026a) ; Yan et al. (2026) , both of which are costly. Both causes trace back to one bottleneck: evidence is expensive to recover once a question has been written .

paragraphs.en: To remove this bottleneck, we propose FoG (Figure 1 ), a framework that trains KG agents to retrieve the evidence behind their answers. Our key observation is that evidence is hard to recover after a question is written but can be embedded when the question is constructed and then rewarded during training. First, evidence-grounded synthesis recursively hides the explicit entities of a seed question behind verifiable sub-questions, so every question carries its supporting triples. Second, a KG interaction agent answers through multi-turn KG queries and records every triple that the KG returns. Lastly, during RL training, an evidence-coverage process reward (ECPR) gives a dense reward to each turn that first retrieves one of these supporting triples. Our contributions are as follows:

paragraphs.en: We distinguish two roles of the KG and show that existing training data and rewards serve it only as a source of answers, not of evidence.

paragraphs.en: We propose FoG, which embeds supporting triples into synthetic questions and rewards their retrieval through ECPR, so the dense reward comes from data synthesis with no LLM judge or extra annotation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 FoG，它将支持性三元组嵌入合成问题中，并通过 ECPR 对其检索进行奖励，因此密集奖励来自数据合成，无需 LLM 评判或额外标注。

paragraphs.en: On three benchmarks, 3B–4B FoG agents outperform larger baselines in accuracy and evidence coverage, and transfer zero-shot across KGs.
paragraphs.zh: 在三个基准测试中，3B–4B 的 FoG 智能体在准确率和证据覆盖率上超越了更大的基线模型，并能在不同知识图谱之间实现零样本迁移。

paragraphs.en: Unlike prompting strategies ( Wei et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2023 ; Yao et al., 2023a ; Jin et al., 2024 ) , KG-augmented methods ground reasoning in verifiable triples and follow two paradigms. Retrieval-based methods ( Luo et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2025 ; Mavromatis and Karypis, 2025 ; He et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) condition the LLM on triples, paths, or subgraphs retrieved in a single step. Agent-based methods ( Sun et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Lin et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) explore the KG iteratively: ToG and PoG prompt a frozen LLM, whereas recent work trains the agent with RL ( Lin et al., 2025 ; Song et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Wang and Yu, 2026b ; Sun et al., 2026a ) . However, these agents use the KG only as a source of answers and can answer correctly without retrieving the supporting triples. In this work, we train agents to use it as a source of evidence.

paragraphs.en: Synthetic data frees KGQA from human annotation, since questions can be generated from the KG and verified by execution. It provides questions for agent training ( Xu et al., 2026 ) and for benchmarking and retriever training ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Cattaneo et al., 2026 ) . However, these pipelines treat it as extra examples to train or evaluate on. In this work, we treat it as a source of supervision: every synthesized question carries the evidence that defines its reward.
paragraphs.zh: 合成数据使 KGQA 摆脱了人工标注，因为问题可以从知识图谱中生成，并通过执行来验证。 它为智能体训练（Xu et al., 2026）以及基准测试和检索器训练（Zhang et al., 2025；Cattaneo et al., 2026）提供了问题。 然而，这些流水线只是将其作为用于训练或评估的额外样本。 在本工作中，我们将其视为一种监督来源：每个合成问题都携带着定义其奖励的证据。

paragraphs.en: RL lets a KG agent learn its retrieval policy from interaction with the KG. Most work trains from outcome rewards on the final answer with rule-based terms for valid interaction ( Lin et al., 2025 ; Song et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Wang and Yu, 2026b ; Sun et al., 2026a ; Sun and Kazakov, 2026 ) . Because outcome rewards are sparse, later work adds dense process rewards, obtained from an LLM judge ( Wang and Yu, 2026a ) or from gold paths and logical forms ( Yan et al., 2026 ; Han et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026b ) . However, both sources are costly: a judge must score every rollout, and gold references must be annotated or recovered for every question. In this work, the process reward comes from data synthesis: every synthesized question already carries its supporting triples, which provide a dense reward at no extra cost.

paragraphs.en: FoG achieves the best F1 and Hit@1 on all three benchmarks, exceeding the strongest baseline KG-R1 by up to +3.73 F1 and +3.92 Hit@1. As KG-R1 is also RL-trained on the same Qwen3-4B backbone, this indicates that training an agent to retrieve evidence also makes its answers more accurate.

paragraphs.en: Full FoG improves over SFT only by +6.83 and +4.33 Hit@1, but RL without R ecpr R_{\text{ecpr}} raises Cov by only +2.28 and +1.58. This is because the outcome reward is paid in full once the answer is reached, whatever evidence is retrieved.

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 5 and Figure 6 , we compare first-match with trajectory-level attribution, which credits coverage to the final turn, and every-match attribution, which rewards every retrieval.

paragraphs.en: First-match achieves the best Hit@1 and Cov. Trajectory-level attribution loses 4.35 Cov, as turns that retrieve evidence earn the same return as the others. paragraphs.en: In this work, we present FoG, a framework that trains KG agents to retrieve the evidence behind their answers. By introducing evidence-grounded synthesis, a KG interaction agent, and an evidence-coverage process reward, FoG uses the KG as a source of evidence rather than only as a source of answers. Experiments on three KGQA benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements in answer accuracy, evidence coverage, and cross-KG transfer.
paragraphs.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出了 FoG，一个训练知识图谱智能体检索其答案背后证据的框架。 通过引入证据锚定的合成方法、一个知识图谱交互智能体以及一种证据覆盖的过程奖励，FoG 将知识图谱用作证据来源，而不仅仅是答案来源。 在三个 KGQA 基准上的实验表明，答案准确率、证据覆盖率和跨知识图谱迁移能力均获得了一致的提升。

sents.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出了 FoG，一个训练知识图谱智能体检索其答案背后证据的框架。

sents.en: By introducing evidence-grounded synthesis, a KG interaction agent, and an evidence-coverage process reward, FoG uses the KG as a source of evidence rather than only as a source of answers.
sents.zh: 通过引入证据锚定的合成方法、一个知识图谱交互智能体以及一种证据覆盖的过程奖励，FoG 将知识图谱用作证据来源，而不仅仅是答案来源。

sents.zh: 在三个 KGQA 基准上的实验表明，答案准确率、证据覆盖率和跨知识图谱迁移能力均获得了一致的提升。

paragraphs.en: FoG uses Wikidata triples as verifiable references for evidence-covered supervision, but real-world knowledge graphs may be incomplete, outdated, or noisy. When the required evidence is absent or incorrect in the graph, the agent may still fail despite following the intended evidence path. A natural extension is to equip the agent with a mechanism for detecting insufficient on-graph evidence and invoking external retrieval when needed.
paragraphs.zh: FoG 使用 Wikidata 三元组作为可验证的参考，用于有证据覆盖的监督，但现实世界的知识图谱可能不完整、过时或含有噪声。 当所需的证据在图谱中缺失或不正确时，智能体即使遵循了预期的证据路径，仍可能失败。 一个自然的扩展方向是为智能体配备一种机制，用于检测图上证据不足并在需要时调用外部检索。

paragraphs.en: Like other KG agents distilled from teacher trajectories ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2026a ) , FoG currently relies on an external teacher LLM (Kimi-K2) for question synthesis and trajectory distillation. Although symbolic checks filter invalid questions and evidence paths, the synthesis process still depends on the generation quality of external teachers. One promising direction is to replace teacher-driven synthesis with self-play, where agents generate, explore, and verify candidate questions through graph execution and symbolic filtering.
paragraphs.zh: 与其他从教师轨迹蒸馏而来的KG智能体（Chen et al., 2025；Sun et al., 2026a）类似，FoG 目前仍依赖外部教师 LLM（Kimi-K2）进行问题合成与轨迹蒸馏。 尽管符号检查可以过滤无效的问题和证据路径，但合成过程仍然依赖外部教师的生成质量。 一个有前景的方向是用自博弈取代教师驱动的合成，即让智能体通过图执行和符号过滤来生成、探索并验证候选问题。

paragraphs.en: FoG caps graph interactions at 10 turns, which is sufficient for the 1–4-hop questions studied in our benchmarks. More open-ended KG reasoning may require longer evidence chains and broader graph exploration. Extending FoG to such settings requires balancing search depth against error accumulation, noisy observations, and sparser rewards.
paragraphs.zh: FoG 将图交互限制在 10 轮，这对于我们基准中研究的 1–4 跳问题已经足够。 更开放的知识图谱推理可能需要更长的证据链和更广的图探索。 将 FoG 扩展到此类场景需要在搜索深度与错误累积、噪声观测以及更稀疏的奖励之间进行权衡。

paragraphs.en: All experiments use publicly available KGQA datasets derived from Wikidata (CC0), QALD10-en (MIT License), and WikiWebQuestions, GTSQA, and WebQSP (publicly available for research). Backbone models Qwen2.5 and Qwen3 are released under Apache 2.0; GPT-4o-mini, DeepSeek-V3, and the teacher Kimi-K2 are accessed via official APIs under their terms of service. Our use of all existing artifacts is consistent with their intended research purposes. The datasets contain only public encyclopedic facts from structured KG triples, with no private or user-generated data. The only human involvement is the audit of constructed evidence paths (Appendix F.3 ), in which three graduate annotators judged whether a KG path supports its question. The annotators took part voluntarily, the task exposed them to no sensitive content, and no personal data was collected. This work involves no crowdsourcing and no user study. FoG is intended to make the answers of KG agents traceable to retrieved evidence. Since the KG may be outdated or incorrect, this evidence supports human verification rather than replaces it. We foresee no dual-use concerns.

paragraphs.en: Redundancy Check. To provide a clear overview of the non-redundancy check in Section 3.1 , we present its procedure in the form of pseudocode. As shown in Algorithm 1 , we first build a support graph from the supporting triples and extract the shortest path from each topic entity to the answer node. We then enumerate proper subsets of topic entities in increasing size and execute one SPARQL query per subset. If any subset yields an answer set no larger than that of the full query, the question admits a shortcut and is discarded.
paragraphs.zh: 冗余检查。 为了清晰概览3.1节中的非冗余检查，我们以伪代码的形式给出其流程。 如算法1所示，我们首先根据支持三元组构建支持图，并提取从每个主题实体到答案节点的最短路径。 然后，我们按规模递增的顺序枚举主题实体的真子集，并对每个子集执行一次SPARQL查询。 如果任何子集得到的答案集不大于完整查询的答案集，则该问题存在捷径，将被丢弃。

paragraphs.en: Complexity Analysis. Given a question with | E q | |E_{q}| topic entities and | 𝒮 ( n ) | |\mathcal{S}^{(n)}| supporting triples, extracting the shortest paths by BFS takes 𝒪 ⁡ ( | E q | ⋅ | 𝒮 ( n ) | ) \mathcal{O}(|E_{q}|\cdot|\mathcal{S}^{(n)}|) time. The subset enumeration issues at most 2 | E q | − 2 2^{|E_{q}|}-2 SPARQL queries and stops at the first redundant subset. Using only the shortest path per topic entity is an approximation, which we audit on 200 candidate questions against an exhaustive enumeration of all path combinations under the same hop limit. The shortest-path check misses a shortcut in 1.5% of the candidates, while issuing 5.1 rather than 48.6 SPARQL queries per question.

paragraphs.en: Adaptation to Wikidata. RoG, SubGraphRAG, and GCR were proposed on Freebase and rely on dataset-specific supervision, so they cannot be transferred to a new KG without retraining. paragraphs.zh: 适配 Wikidata。 RoG、SubGraphRAG 和 GCR 是在 Freebase 上提出的，并依赖于特定数据集的监督信号，因此无法在不重新训练的情况下迁移到新的知识图谱。 因此，我们在每个 Wikidata 基准的训练集上对它们逐一进行重新训练。 KG-R1 同样是在 Freebase 上提出的。 我们使用与 FoG 相同的训练数据在 Wikidata 上对其进行重新训练。

paragraphs.en: To better understand how much of the supporting evidence different methods retrieve from the KG, we present a case study on the question: “Which airline flies the Embraer 195 and is based at the airport named after Margaret Kenyatta’s father?” As shown in Tables 14 , 15 , and 16 , this question requires resolving the father, the airport named after him, and the airline that is based there and flies the aircraft. All three methods predict the correct answer, but they differ in how much of the evidence chain they recover.
paragraphs.zh: 为了更好地理解不同方法能从知识图谱中检索到多少支持证据，我们对问题「哪家航空公司运营 Embraer 195，并且基地位于以 Margaret Kenyatta 的父亲命名的机场？」进行了案例研究。如表 14、15 和 16 所示，这个问题需要解析出她的父亲、以其命名的机场，以及驻扎在该机场并运营该机型的航空公司。 三种方法都预测出了正确答案，但它们恢复出的证据链完整程度各不相同。

paragraphs.en: FoG recovers the complete gold evidence. It issues nine KG turns and grounds each hop in the triples returned by the previous one, so every link of the chain can be read from the trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: FoG 恢复出完整的黄金证据。 它发起九轮知识图谱（KG）交互，并将每一跳都锚定在上一轮返回的三元组上，因此链条的每一环都可以从轨迹中读出。

paragraphs.en: In contrast, ToG performs four rounds of beam search but recovers only one relevant triple, missing the links for airport naming and airline hub, so its answer relies mainly on parametric knowledge. PoG answers after a single retrieval step, leaving an evidence chain that cannot be audited from the trajectory. This case highlights the strength of FoG in reaching the answer through evidence that is fully retrieved from the KG.
paragraphs.zh: 相比之下，ToG 进行了四轮束搜索，却只找回一条相关三元组，遗漏了机场命名和航空枢纽相关的链接，因此其答案主要依赖参数化知识。 PoG 在单次检索步骤后就给出答案，留下的证据链无法从轨迹中进行审计。 该案例凸显了 FoG 的优势：通过完全从知识图谱中检索到的证据得出答案。
